Tashlhiyt vowel starvation and consonant clustering deform the vocal lines into vowelless rhythmic units, while kamancheh, claviolin, DTMF touch-tones, and contact-mic table textures generate a trashy, obsessively focused spectacle of raw physical friction and structural tension across hyper-detailed concentric ring spatialization layers.
